fgfr3_ic50.label: FGFR3 wild-type IC50
fgfr3_ic50.note: FGFR3 enzymatic screening drove the SAR, which is why it is the primary axis even though FGFR2 potency mattered equally in the end.

fgfr1_ic50.label: FGFR1 IC50
fgfr1_ic50.note: The isoform to avoid: FGFR1 inhibition is the hypothesised cause of the hyperphosphataemia seen with the approved pan-FGFR drugs. A HIGHER value is the better outcome.

fgfr1_fold.label: FGFR1 selectivity over FGFR3 (as published)
fgfr1_fold.note: Printed by the paper as R1/R3. Carried across as published, never recomputed.

fgfr2_ic50.label: FGFR2 IC50
fgfr2_ic50.note: Equal FGFR2 potency was desirable but not a formal goal of the campaign.

fgfr3_v555l_ic50.label: FGFR3 V555L gatekeeper mutant IC50
fgfr3_v555l_ic50.note: A resistance mutant of the target, not an anti-target: potency here is wanted, and losing it is how the approved drugs fail.

wb_ic50.label: Whole blood IC50
wb_ic50.conditions: FGFR3 RT-112/84 cells in whole blood

flt3_ic50.label: FLT3 IC50
flt3_ic50.note: One of four kinases an early analogue hit below 100 nM. Higher is better.

cyp3a4_ic50.label: CYP3A4 inhibition IC50
cyp3a4_ic50.note: An inhibition IC50 where a HIGHER value is the better result: this is the liability the campaign spent its last three compounds removing.

fassif_solubility.label: Solubility in fasted-state simulated intestinal fluid
fassif_solubility.note: The paper prints this column as FASSIF in Table 5 and FaSSIF in Table 7. One assay, two spellings: the id is normalised here and both source strings are recorded in ISSUES.md.

rat_po_auc.label: Rat oral AUC
rat_po_auc.note: Doses differ between compounds: read the source note before comparing.

rat_iv_hbf.label: Rat clearance as hepatic blood flow

rat_iv_vdss.label: Rat volume of distribution at steady state
